author: Connor Creates
description:
10/10 recommend trying Cometeer coffee: https://cometeer.com/connorcreates

I have a new appreciation for the ancient art of origami! What started as a crazy idea in my head turned into a multi-day project of lots of trial, error, hard work and patience. 

In the end I'm proud that I was able to make a giant sized origami boat from nothing but paper and foam! Let me know if you have any ideas on how I can improve it!

Come say hi on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/connorcreates/
And subscribe here on YT: youtube.com/@itsConnorCreates

thanks for being here to watch and support what I make! It's such a blessing to be doing this as a job, and I truly value your time. so thank you for watching!
title: I Built a Giant Origami Boat
